review:
Mighty Crown: Legacy of Mars is a classic fruit-and-sevens slot from Wazdan, set on a cosmic background. A classic fruit-and-sevens game dressed up in a cosmic Mars theme, on 10 fixed paylines. Crown Scatters drive everything: 2, 3, 4 or 5 of them award different jackpots, and five pay the 3,000x Grand.

There's a second way to the Grand too: fill all 15 positions with Sevens. Scatter Respin helps along the way, locking one Crown for the next spin so you have a better chance of adding more. Chance Level multiplies the bet by x2, x5 or x10 for better jackpot odds. Wazdan rates it medium volatility with a 96.15% RTP. Simple rules, but more going on than most retro slots. Try the free demo to see how often the Crowns stack up.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
